speaker: charlie
text: Sportswise, it is school holidays which means it is also junior footy sign up season, and the numbers coming through for girls rugby league this year are seriously impressive. Clubs right across Queensland are reporting waiting lists, which is the kind of problem every coach wants to have.

speaker: alice
text: I love that, a whole new generation growing up thinking footy for girls is just completely normal. Give it a few years and we will be watching some of these kids running out in Maroon on the big stage.

speaker: charlie
text: That is the dream alright. Grassroots sport doing exactly what it is meant to do, getting kids outside and having a crack.
